identity.description: Waterfall.io (waterfall.io) is a B2B contact and company data enrichment company whose GTM API runs a waterfall across 30+ data vendors. It is not the Waterfall Lead Enrichment MCP (Workato), Waterfall Bridge (finance), or getwaterfall.org (LLM API).
identity.identity_notes: Confirmed by the vendor homepage, the official docs site, and the vendor GitHub org (Waterfall-io). A Cargo integration doc also names Waterfall.io. Third-party aggregator sites were used only as leads. Several unrelated 'waterfall' products share the name.

auth.token_refresh: Not applicable (static API key). Docs say 'Rotate keys periodically' with no schedule.
auth.scopes_notes: No OAuth or scopes documented. Master API keys manage sub-keys; sub-keys are for separating access and usage per team or workflow.

access.production_restrictions: No self-serve signup found. Homepage directs visitors to 'Book a Call' and a request form. Pricing is described as usage-based, prepaid credits. Whether a trial or test key exists is not established.

api.limitations: Breadth is mostly data lookups and enrichment, with no CRM-style write resources. Writes are limited to key management and async enrichment jobs. Method per endpoint not stated in docs beyond POST for sync results. Homepage examples all show /v1/prospector, so labels may not match endpoints.
